content:
Use `waterfall-integration` when Waterfall will be part of your application or a recurring workflow. The skill guides an agent to create Python or JavaScript/TypeScript integration code in your repository, using your stack and conventions. Your team owns and maintains that code. For a lookup you want to run now, use [Run a lookup](/v1/skills-direct-api).

## Install the skill

```
npx skills add Waterfall-io/api-skills --skill waterfall-integration
```

The skill is published in the [Waterfall API Skills repository](https://github.com/Waterfall-io/api-skills). It provides integration guidance. Live API calls still need an authorized key and follow your account’s usage and billing terms.

## Describe what you want to build

Give the agent your starting inputs, required output fields, and the place where the workflow belongs in your application. Specify your existing HTTP client, how results should be stored, and whether the task includes live calls. The skill includes a live API call to verify the generated code. If you only want code and mocked tests, say so explicitly, as in the example below. For example:

> Add Waterfall Contact Enrichment to our signup workflow. Start with the signup email and use our existing HTTP client. Save the returned job ID with the signup record and retrieve the result. Map available title and company fields into the enrichment record; keep missing fields empty and do not overwrite existing CRM values. Leave phone enrichment off and keep the API key on the server. Add mocked checks for running, completed, and failed jobs. Do not make live API calls in this task.

Start with [signup enrichment](/v1/use-cases/signup-enrichment) for the workflow and [Quickstart](/v1/quickstart) for the request sequence. Use [Choose an API](/v1/introduction) for other tasks.

## What to review in the integration

Confirm that the code uses the documented inputs, reads the result fields your task needs, and handles missing data and unsuccessful jobs. Your integration decides when to submit requests and how to update your own records. See [Authentication](/v1/authentication), [Errors](/v1/errors), and [Usage Tracking](/v1/inline-usage) for API behavior. The current endpoint references take precedence if the skill’s instructions differ.
